statement: For every deterministic finite mixed label setF withu input andv output indices, the proved marginal joint laws give P(F_in subset Bad)<=q^(2u) and P(F_out subset Bad)<=q^(2v). Without assuming input/output independence, Cauchy-Schwarz gives P(F subset Bad)<=sqrt(q^(2u)*q^(2v))=q^|F|. The actual causal/injective/order-preserving clean matching accounts for deletions,insertions,wrongbits/framing,cross-port errors and latency>zeta. Any potential label not occurred byT is absent; no conditioning on rare arrivals or postselectedgood event is used. TakeG=Omega, so P(G^c)=0 satisfies CTexp(-cL^a),e.g.c=a=1, and the law holds for all horizons, stronger than onlyT<=exp(cL^a/2). This FULL POSITIVE theorem is for the written adjacent opposite-face-port model; it is not a claim of growing-distance transport, global clock alignment, coherent/CPTP robustness or quantum-memory threshold.
